items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Mutt Carey came up to me and asked did I want a job in the taxi dance to play with him... Mutt Carey led the band.

ctx.x: Mutt Carey came up to me and asked did I want a job in the taxi dance to play with him. A place called the Liberty Dance Hall. It was a Mexican dance hall. They had a lot of Mexican girls, and a lot of Filipinas used to come in there, too. The taxi dances was a thing...
That was a four-piece band or something?
